option.value:
<% provide(:title, "Users Reports") %>

User Report

<%= form_with url: profiles_show_path, method: :get, local: true do |f| %>
<%= f.label :user_id, "Taskbridge Users", class: "capitalize text-sm font-bold w-full align-middle pt-3" %>
<% users = User.with_role(:agent).or(User.with_role(:project_manager)).or(User.with_role(:admin)) %> <% users.each do |user| %>
<%= user.name || user.email %>
<% end %>
<%= f.label :start_date, "Start Date", class: "capitalize text-sm font-bold w-full align-middle pt-3" %> <%= f.date_field :start_date, class: "border border-gray-300 rounded-md font-medium placeholder-current focus:outline-none dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-50 dark:text-slate-100 w-full" %>
<%= f.label :end_date, "End Date", class: "capitalize text-sm font-bold w-full align-middle pt-3" %> <%= f.date_field :end_date, class: "border border-gray-300 rounded-md font-medium placeholder-current focus:outline-none dark:bg-gray-700 dark:border-gray-50 dark:text-slate-100 w-full" %>
<%= f.submit "Generate Report", class: 'mb-4 h-12 bg-[#3F8CFF] hover:bg-[#3A81EB] p-3 rounded font-bold rounded-lg text-slate-100' %>
<% end %>
<% if @users&.any? %>

Assignment Report for <%= @users.first.name || "#{@users.first.first_name} #{@users.first.last_name}" %> <% if params[:start_date].present? || params[:end_date].present? %> from <%= params[:start_date] %> to <%= params[:end_date] %> <% end %>

Ticket Status Summary

<%= column_chart @status_counts, height: "300px", library: { title: { text: "Ticket Status Distribution" }, plotOptions: { series: { colors: @status_counts.keys.map { |status| status == "Closed" ? "black" : nil } } } } %>
    <% @status_counts.each do |status, count| %>
  • <%= status %>: <%= count %>
    • <% end %>
<%= pie_chart [ ["Met Deadline", @users.sum { |user| user.tickets.count { |ticket| SlaTicket.find_by(ticket_id: ticket.id)&.sla_target_response_deadline == "Not Breached" } }], ["Missed Deadline", @users.sum { |user| user.tickets.count { |ticket| SlaTicket.find_by(ticket_id: ticket.id)&.sla_target_response_deadline == "Breached" } }], ["Pending", @users.sum { |user| user.tickets.count { |ticket| SlaTicket.find_by(ticket_id: ticket.id)&.sla_target_response_deadline.nil? } }] ] %>
<%= link_to "Download CSV", profiles_show_user_path(format: :csv, start_date: params[:start_date], end_date: params[:end_date], user_id: params[:user_id]), class: "mb-4 mt-4 h-12 bg-[#3F8CFF] hover:bg-[#3A81EB] p-3 rounded font-bold rounded-lg text-slate-100" %>
<% @tickets_by_client.each do |client_name, tickets| %> <% end %>
Client Name Number of Tickets View Tickets
<%= client_name %> <%= tickets.count %> <%= link_to "View Tickets", profiles_show_user_path(user_id: params[:user_id], client_name: client_name, start_date: params[:start_date], end_date: params[:end_date]), class: 'bg-[#3A81EB] p-2 rounded font-bold rounded-lg text-slate-100' %>

Assignment Events

<% if @events.present? %> <% grouped_events = @events.group_by { |event| event.try(:ticket)&.unique_id || "-" } %> <% grouped_events.each do |unique_id, events| %> <% latest_event = events.max_by(&:created_at) %> <% ticket = latest_event.try(:ticket) %> <% info = parse_assignment_details(latest_event.try(:details)) %> <% assigned_at = assigned_at_for(ticket) %> <% resolved_at = resolved_at_for(ticket) %> <% duration = resolution_duration_for(ticket) %> <% end %>
Ticket Unique ID (Assign Count) Assigned To / SLA Status / Deadline View Ticket Assigned At Resolved At Total time user held the ticket Time to Resolved / Open Since
<%= "#{unique_id} (#{events.size})" %>
Assigned To: <%= info[:assigned_to] || "Unknown" %>
SLA Status: <%= info[:sla_status] || "N/A" %>
Target Response Deadline: <%= info[:target_deadline] || "N/A" %>
 <% if ticket %> <%= link_to 'VIEW', polymorphic_path([ticket.project, ticket]), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer", class: 'bg-[#3A81EB] p-2 rounded font-bold rounded-lg text-slate-100' %> <% end %> <%= assigned_at ? assigned_at.strftime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M') : "-" %> <%= resolved_at ? resolved_at.strftime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M') : "-" %> <% hold_periods = @total_hold_times[ticket.id] || [] %> <% if hold_periods.any? %>
    <% hold_periods.each_with_index do |period, idx| %>
  • <%= "Period #{idx + 1}: #{distance_of_time_in_words(Time.at(0), Time.at(period), include_seconds: true)}" %>
    • <% end %>
<% else %> - <% end %> 		<% if duration %> <%= "#{duration[:human]} (from #{(assigned_at || ticket.created_at).strftime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M')})" %> <% else %> <%= "#{ticket.created_at.strftime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M')} to #{Time.current.strftime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M')} (#{time_ago_in_words(ticket.created_at)} and counting)" %> <% end %>
<% if @avg_assignment_to_resolved_seconds %> Average time from assignment to resolution across <%= pluralize(@avg_assignment_to_resolved_count, 'ticket') %>: <%= @avg_assignment_to_resolved_human %> <% else %> No resolved tickets with an assignment time to compute an average. <% end %>
<% else %>

No assignment events found for the selected criteria.

<% end %>

All Comments

<% if @issues.present? %> <% grouped_issues = @issues.group_by { |issue| issue.ticket&.unique_id } %> <% grouped_issues.each do |unique_id, issues| %> <% ticket = issues.first.ticket %> <% end %>
Ticket ID Issues View Created At
<%= "#{unique_id} (#{issues.size})" %> <% issues.each do |issue| %>
<%= (issue.try(:content)&.to_plain_text&.truncate(80)) || issue.try(:name) || issue.try(:title) || "Issue ##{issue.id}" %>
<% end %> 		<% if ticket %> <%= link_to 'VIEW', polymorphic_path([ticket.project, ticket]), target: "_blank", rel: "noopener noreferrer", class: 'bg-[#3A81EB] p-2 rounded font-bold rounded-lg text-slate-100' %> <% end %> <%= issues.map(&:created_at).compact.max&.strftime('%d-%m-%Y %H:%M') %>
<% else %>

No issues found for the selected criteria.

<% end %>
<% end %>
